title: Triple sign moment with a conjunction
statement: Choose signs $a,b\in\{−1,1\}$ independently and uniformly, and let their conjunction be $-1$ exactly when both are $-1$, and $1$ otherwise. The expected value of the product of $a$, $b$, and this conjunction is $-1/2$.
